hooks.name: Check icon catalog is current
hooks.description: Regenerates the icon catalog and reports if it differs from the saved file.

action.command: cp src/icons/catalog.ts /tmp/catalog.before.ts && npm run icons >/dev/null 2>&1; if diff -q /tmp/catalog.before.ts src/icons/catalog.ts >/dev/null; then echo "Icon catalog is up to date."; else echo "Icon catalog was out of date and has been regenerated."; fi
